digest.component_or_area: DC renderer (wiki_render.py) and pandoc subprocess management
propositions: Pandoc subprocess can hang indefinitely on pathological input without a caller-side timeout, blocking reconciliation for 13.5+ minutes at high CPU
subprocess.run(timeout=) reaps only the direct child process, leaving grandchild spinners orphaned when the jira reader holds pipes
The bundled pandoc binary from pypandoc-binary wheel lacks GPL license provenance recording in the repository
The renderer must use subprocess.Popen with start_new_session=True and process-group reaping on timeout to kill hanging grandchildren reliably
Configuration key reconciler.dc_pandoc_timeout_s (default 10s) must control the pandoc timeout across config file, environment variables, and schema validation
Rendered output must remain byte-identical to the original landed renderer for all 178 committed corpus bodies to prove changes affect robustness only
